node.title: L1 official-reserve tame-refinement router
node.statement: Let the generated evaluation field be F_(p^f), with n=2^m>=2^13, n|p^f-1, p^f<2^256, and k<=n/2. Given any corrected-reserve threshold sigma, reduce by exact-shell monotonicity to the least threshold sigma_0 for eta=min(epsilon,1/4), and put ell_0=sigma_0+1. The power-of-two order bound ord_n(p)>=n/(p+1), the field cap (which excludes p=3,5), and binom(n,a)<=2^n give ell_0<=ceil(5(p+1)/(4 log_2 p))+1<p. Hence p does not divide ell_0/s for any s|ell_0. Every whole-petal refinement at the canonical official cutoff is tame, so the fixed-petal census counts all map classes by at most M_src tau(ell_0)<=n. Wild fixed-petal decomposition is removed from the L1 frontier; role/support payment, partial fibers, unanchored maps, and arbitrary locators remain open.
